title_en: You have a right to be safe from violence at home
law: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, Sections 3 and 18 to 22
rule_plain: Domestic violence is not only hitting. It also covers sexual, verbal, emotional and money abuse, and harm over dowry demands. A woman has the right to live in her shared home. The court can give her a protection order, a right to stay in the home, money for herself and her children, custody of her children and compensation.
what_you_can_do: Go to the Protection Officer. Protection Officers are appointed by the government to help you file the case and get legal aid.
You can also file the petition at the Judicial Magistrate Court, with a service provider, or at the nearby police station.
Service providers can help you write the Domestic Incident Report, give you a short stay home with your children, counselling and medical help.
In an emergency, call the Women Helpline 181.
where_to_get_help: Protection Officer of your district (Social Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu), a service provider, the Judicial Magistrate Court or the police. Women Helpline 181.
